BootKernel.description:
The boot kernel identity.

All three of D07's facts are recorded at once: which source is in force,
the distribution package that boots by default, and the requirement payload
any kernel must satisfy. A manifest therefore says who currently builds the
kernel without losing what the kernel has to be.

default-package.description: The pinned distribution package D07 makes the default.

BootKernelSource.description: Where the boot kernel comes from (decision D07, amended by D70).

oneOf.description: The pinned distribution package, which D07 makes the default.
The kernel this repository builds while Nucleus is a scaffold (D70, M26).

A producer artifact consumed through the M09 contract, which D07 lets
override the default once it exists.

DefinitionReferences.description: Where the reviewed configuration inputs live in this repository.

kernel-requirement.description: The kernel requirement payload the kernel build consumes.

mkosi.description: The mkosi configuration the image gate resolves.

DistributionId.description:
The distributions an Aegis image may be built from.

The spelling is mkosi's own `Distribution=` value, so the manifest and the
image configuration name the same thing.

DistributionPin.description:
The pinned distribution input (decision D18).

There is no unpinned spelling: [`SnapshotId`] refuses `latest`, which is
the value REQ-P01-01 records as the reason the image inputs are not
reproducible today.

id.description: The distribution the image is built from.

snapshot.description: The dated snapshot every package version is resolved against.

ProductInputVersion.description: The contract versions of the product input manifest this build admits.

RetryPolicy.description: The bounded retry budget for one request across the boundary.

backoff-seconds.description: How long to wait between attempts, in seconds.

max-attempts.description: How many attempts one request may make in total.

correlation-id.description: The identifier threading this request and its result together.

definitions.description: Where the reviewed configuration inputs live.

packages.description: The image content set the recorded requirements name.

items.description:
One package name in the pinned image content set.

The charset is the one a pacman package name uses. No version is carried:
on a dated snapshot the repository holds exactly one version of each
package, so the [`SnapshotId`] is the version pin and a second, separately
maintained one could only disagree with it.

revision.description: The exact source revision the referenced inputs were read at.

schema.description: The contract version this payload claims.
